query: TAC Protocol TAC token price trajectory and news July 2026, vesting unlocks, recent trend, technical analysis support resistance
answer:
I've completed the research on TAC Protocol. Here's a summary of the key findings:

**TAC Protocol (TAC) — as of July 17, 2026**

- **Current price:** ~$0.0034, market cap ~$16.3M (down ~95% from ATH)
- **All-time high:** $0.06715 on June 30, 2026
- **Central event:** A **>90% flash crash in early July 2026** (from ~$0.06 to ~$0.005–0.0063 in 15 minutes) around Binance Alpha/Futures listing activity

**Crash cause (per team @TacBuild):** A large perpetual-futures sell order overwhelmed thin liquidity, cascading into liquidations. Team denied any exploit or insider selling, stating team/investor tokens remain locked.

**Major risk — extreme concentration:** Top 5 wallets hold 41.47%, top 10 hold 72.34%, Gini 0.9938.

**Vesting/unlocks:** 27.24% vested (~729 days left); 2.39B TAC locked; next unlock ~99.43M TAC (~0.99% of supply, ~$333K) was imminent.

**Technical analysis:** Post-crash recovery (a +61.94% session) forming a rounded bottom off ~$0.0020 support. Resistance at ~$0.00727 and ~$0.01021. RSI ~34 (climbing from oversold) but price far below the 50 EMA ($0.0192) — still structurally bearish.

**Important caveat:** Sources have notable date confusion (2025 mainnet/listing vs. 2026 crash), and some price-prediction pages (e.g., Phemex July 9 showing ~$0.046–0.051) are stale/pre-crash and conflict with current ~$0.0034 data. The full report and structured data (11 key facts, 22 data points, 13 sources) have been submitted.
